shared_elements: rectilinear/geometric divisions of the field (block-like or panel-like shapes)
curved arc form (A) vs. wheel circle (B) as isolated curved motifs
justification: A shows only a schematic rectilinear grid of block-like shapes with a single curved arc, essentially an architectural/geometric pattern, while B shows a fully figural narrative scene: a team of horses drawing a wheeled chariot with several armed men, over a ground of scale-like mounds and wavy water lines. The only correspondence is the generic use of incised outline in shallow relief and some rectangular and curved forms; no creature, human figure, or relational motif is shared.
